info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens OpenAI Embeddings API

items.docs: Creates an embedding vector representing the input text. This endpoint is compatible with the [OpenAI Embeddings API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/embeddings) and may be used with the OpenAI JS or Python SDK by setting the base URL to `https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/openai`.
Returns a list of available embedding models. This endpoint is compatible with the OpenAI Models API format.
